heading: Lost n Stolen
content:
Lost n StolenCustomer calls the bank for lost/stolen card.Customer presented with pre-menu option in the contact flow, and selects 'lost n stolen' option.In the 'lost n stolen' option, customer will be presented with further options to Temporary block/unblock or Replace the card.Temporary Block/UnblockIf customer selects block/unblock option then customer is first authenticated via Phone Number or 16 Digit card number and then 4 digit pin.( Refer this High Level Design - Contact Center Re-Platform - MVP (PCI)#2.4UseCaseRealization)Once verified, Amazon Connect invokes 'TemporaryBlockCard' lambda with customer 'accountid' and 'customerid' to hit the TSYS API to block/unblock the customer card.
